worst_queue_order_count.meaning: number of orders in the worst price limit queue

new_order_introduces_new_limit.meaning: the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue on the order book side

max_limits_reached.meaning: the side's limit count has reached maxNumLimitsPerSide

least_competitive_order_removed.meaning: the least competitive price order is removed from the order book side

assumptions: The order-addition action is the operation under analysis; no caller authorization condition is stated in the report.
The report's requirement applies when the side's limit count reaches maxNumLimitsPerSide; the concrete value of maxNumLimitsPerSide is not given.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the concrete value of maxNumLimitsPerSide, so the 'reached maxNumLimitsPerSide' trigger is encoded as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric bound.
Report does not state the exact number of orders in the worst price queue, only that it is more than one.

limitations: The maxNumLimitsPerSide-reached trigger is represented by a grounded Boolean because the report gives no concrete limit value.
Only the least_competitive_not_removed impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
